data.one_liner: Comprehensive Islamic Hijri calendar library with date conversion, moon phases, and events.
data.what_it_does: Provides accurate Hijri to Gregorian conversion using the Umm al-Qura calendar, along with date math, multi-language support, moon phase calculations and widgets, and Islamic events management.
use_when: You need Hijri and Gregorian date conversion in your Flutter application.
Your app requires Islamic events tracking and localized numerals.
You want to display moon phases or use a horizontal week calendar with Hijri dates.
avoid_when: You only need standard Gregorian calendar date manipulation.
You require custom or non-Umm al-Qura calendar calculation formulas not covered by the library.
strengths: Accurate Umm al-Qura calendar conversions and robust date validation.
Built-in astronomical moon phase calculations and visual widget.
Extensive multi-language support (8 languages) with localized numerals.
Includes major Islamic events with hadiths and statistics.
weaknesses: Tied specifically to the Islamic calendar and Umm al-Qura rules.
